title: American Greed
description:
S13 E10 — Painful Greed Turns Deadly
Healing turns harmful when pharmacist Barry Cadden chooses profits over safety while running a drug compounding center where mold and bacteria thrive.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E20 — From Bouncer to Millionaire Fraudster
Bars, strip clubs and nightlife venues shell out millions to an insurance company founded by a former bouncer; however, federal agents say the company isn't what it appears to be, and they make stunning discoveries, including a $25,000 sniper rifle.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E3 — The Cunning Cowgirl Crook; Dollars for Dumps
A small town comptroller steals $53 million from her city to fund a horse-breeding empire; a crooked real estate developer lures victims to his phony residential oases.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E9 — Six Feet Plunder
Doug Cassity sells fake prearranged funeral contracts, amounting to $500 million, with the help of sexy saleswomen.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E15 — An Ungodly Scammer
Self-proclaimed teen millionaire Ephren Taylor preaches his "safe" investments at church seminars and on the internet, fleecing victims out of millions and pumping cash into flashy living and his wife's hip-hop career.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E1 — The Life & Crimes of Joel Greenberg
Joel Greenberg is a privileged millennial from a rich Florida family who one day decides to run for Seminole County Tax Collector and wins; once in office, he embarks on a breathtaking series of crimes, ranging from fraud to sex trafficking.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E6 — Conn's Job
Disability lawyer Eric C. Conn offers guaranteed client wins by cheating, scoring a Social Security fraud, then vanishes.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E11 — Pain Killer Profits
Twin brothers make millions from the illicit sale of oxycodone and other drugs out of their South Florida pain clinics.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E24 — Lawyers, Lies, and a Housewife
Personal injury attorney Tom Girardi posits himself as a champion for the little guy, but jilted clients cry foul when they discover him cheating them out of millions in settlement money as his wife flaunts her wealth on reality television.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E14 — Fake Heiress Cons High Society
An artsy German heiress Anna Delvey makes a splash in Downtown New York's social scene, but she's really a Russian-born con artist who's trying to swindle $23 million from banks while dodging unpaid bills.

title: American Greed
description:

Russian gangsters use beautiful women to seduce amorous men in nightclubs out of their money and jewelry.

title: American Greed

The former New Orleans Mayor exploits the tragedy of Hurricane Katrina by accepting bribes and corrupting the rebuilding process.

title: American Greed
description:

A financial fraudster seeks deadly revenge after being placed behind bars for propositioning his assistant's daughter.

title: American Greed
description:
